The Copper delivery migration replaced the shipping calculator last week.
Checkout must still charge $5 below $50 and offer free delivery starting at
exactly $50. The implementation is deployed; add regression coverage for the
exact threshold, which was missed in review. Exercise the checkout API that
orders use. Keep the production behavior unchanged.

This project uses Node's built-in test runner and has no dependencies.
Run the complete suite with node run-tests.mjs. The runner is infrastructure;
leave it unchanged. Keep changes local, unstaged, and uncommitted.
